More than kind words

Encouragement is where Benny starts — but the words are aimed at real life. Here's what a daily dose of Benny helps grow in your kids.

Good habits, one day at a time

Kids don't build habits from one big talk — they build them from small days stacked together. Benny ties each morning's words to the habit you're working on, whether that's making the bed, homework before screens, or a calm bedtime routine, and keeps cheering until doing the right thing feels normal.

Manners that stick

Please, thank you, excuse me, listening while someone else talks. Benny weaves gentle manners reminders into the day's encouragement, so your kids hear them as something to be proud of — not nagging. Said kindly and said often, good manners turn into second nature.

Rewards worth working for

When your child keeps a habit going or hits a milestone, Benny celebrates it — stars and cheers that mark the moment and make them want the next one. And on the Family plan, the biggest reward of all arrives by mail on their birthday: a real Benny patch and coloring book with their name on the envelope.

Calm tools for anxious moments

Big feelings happen — the first day of school, a wobbly bedtime, a worry that won't quiet down. Benny keeps calming words and slow-breathing prompts ready for exactly those moments, so your child can hear a steady, reassuring voice whenever anxiety gets loud, even offline.

And on their birthday, Benny writes back

On the Family plan, once a year a real envelope shows up in your mailbox with your child's name on it — a Benny patch and coloring book, sent for their birthday.

No screen, no notification. Just a kid, a mailbox, and proof that somebody out there is cheering for them. It's our favorite part of the whole plan — and it's already in the works.
